title: McpHandleElicitationConfig
description: ADR 0553 P2 — the ask, authored on the node. Under MCP 2026-07-28 there is no inbound `elicitation/create` method (MRTR replaced server-initiated requests), so a workflow that needs input from its MCP caller declares the ask HERE and the host answers the in-flight `tools/call` with `input_required`. The legacy 2025-06-18 bridge still passes the inbound params as `inputs.request`, which wins when present.

message.description: The prompt shown to the caller.

requestedSchema.description: MCP flat form schema (string/number/boolean/enum) describing the answer.
